thread:
emily_cs: Nightingale Labs reached out for a pre-demo network + throughput change for their London pilot. Request from Jordan (jordan@nightingale.ai). They need temporary region steering to europe-lon, an IP allowlist for their demo hosts, and a per-key QPS bump for the demo window.

emily_cs: Core details: org_id `org_nightingale_19`, api_prefix `ng-` (sensitive key shared via secure channel). Demo window: Thu 09:30-12:30 UTC.

emily_cs: Requested config (summary):
```
- Primary region: europe-lon; fallback: eu-north-1
- Allowlist CIDRs: 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.128/25
- Temp per-key QPS: 200 -> 900
- Increase concurrent connections for key prefix: 80 -> 320
- Set soft cap at 1000 QPS internal guardrails
- Auto-expire rules at 2026-04-02T12:30:00Z
```

emily_cs: They also asked for a short note to show to their security team confirming the CIDRs and expiry.

tom_ops: Thanks. Please confirm if they want a dedicated reserved shard or just increased soft limits on the shared pool for the demo. Also need a signed approval doc and final list of source IPs.

emily_cs: They confirmed shared pool is fine for the 3h demo. Signed approval uploaded to ticket. Final source IPs included in the secure note.

infra-bot: Created ticket CS-9210: "Nightingale Labs - LON demo allowlist & temporary QPS bump" assigned to tom_ops, priority: P2.

tom_ops: I'll schedule the change and add an automated rollback at 12:30 UTC. Plan to roll the edge rule at 09:00 UTC and do a quick smoke test at 09:20.

rachel_oncall: Quick capacity check: current europe-lon clusters have enough headroom for short burst to 900 QPS, but we should enable a conservative circuit breaker to 1.1k QPS to protect other tenants. I'll enable metrics alert if p95 latency > 200ms.

tom_ops: Noted. Change will be applied via the internal admin API. Example payload: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-admin.redwood/api/configs \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"org_id":"org_nightingale_19","api_prefix":"ng-","cidrs":["198.51.100.0/24","203.0.113.128/25"],"region":"europe-lon","per_key_qps":900,"conn_limit":320,"expires_at":"2026-04-02T12:30:00Z"}'
```

dan_account: Heads up: Nightingale's renewal conversation is mid-Q2. Team wants notes on demo perf. Please capture any error spikes or client-side retries in CS-9210. Smooth demo helps conversion.

tom_ops: Will attach post-demo telemetry and a short incident-free signoff. Auto-revoke scheduled. Manual verify at 12:40 to ensure cleanup.

infra-bot: CS-9210 status -> scheduled (tags: eng-infra, oncall, customer-success).

emily_cs: Thanks all 6974aa I'll message Jordan with timing and shared runbook (they requested a short checklist).

rachel_oncall: If latency climbs unexpectedly ping me; I can promote an extra node in the shard quickly. Also prefer exact CIDR usage (no 0.0/0).

tom_ops: Closing note: if demo extends past 12:30, we will throttle back to protect multi-tenant pool and notify account team.

emily_cs: Understood. I'll keep Jordan aware of expectations and relay any feedback.
